Reverse Sum = $27 \times 6 - 90 = 162 - 90 = 72$
Logic: Reverse sum me se Number of alphabets ko minus kar diya.
Code = $72 - 6 = 66$

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
INDUCE ka sum nikal: $9 + 14 + 4 + 21 + 3 + 5 = 56$. Reverse sum = $27 \times 6 - 56 = 162 - 56 = 106$. Isme se 6 letters ko ghata de: $106 - 6 = 100$!

questions_hin.q_hi: In a certain code language, 'FRIGHT' is written as 'FOCQED' and 'SHREDS' is written as 'OEPPAB'. How will 'UPSETS' be written in that language?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Bohot pyara concept hai, isko dhyan se dekhna!

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: FRIGHT (6 letters) ko 2 part me tod de: FRI aur GHT. FRIGHT -> FOCQED. FRI ka ulta IRF -> isme -3 karega toh FOC. GHT ka ulta THG -> isme -3 karega toh QED.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): UPSETS ko break kar -> UPS aur ETS. UPS ka reverse SPU -> Sabme -3 kar (S-3=P, P-3=M, U-3=R). Pehla half PMR aagaya. Options me C aur A dono me PMR hai. ETS reverse STE -> Sabme -3 kar (S-3=P, T-3=Q, E-3=B). Pura PQB aayega. Total PMRPQB.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Half-reverse-minus-3 engine: Word = $W_1 W_2 W_3 W_4 W_5 W_6$. Encode = $(W_3-3)(W_2-3)(W_1-3)(W_6-3)(W_5-3)(W_4-3)$. Apply this on UPSETS to get P M R P Q B.

Future Exam Takeaway: 6 letters wale words aksar 3-3 ke chunk me cross subtract hote hain.
